* Summary [#summary]
`EmptyBorder`の余白から生成した角丸の枠領域を虹色のグラデーションで塗りつぶし、その色相が回転するアニメーションを描画します。

#en{{
Fills a rounded rectangular border area generated from the margin of an `EmptyBorder` with a rainbow gradient and animates its rotation.
}}

#download(https://drive.google.com/uc?id=)

* Source Code Examples [#sourcecode]
#code(link){{
class RotatingRainbowBorder extends EmptyBorder {
  protected static final float BORDER_WIDTH = 2f;
  protected static final float CORNER_RADIUS = 12f;
  protected static final int HUE_STEPS = 24;
  protected static final float[] FRACTIONS =
      new float[HUE_STEPS + 1];
  protected static final Color[] COLORS =
      new Color[HUE_STEPS + 1];

  static {
    for (int i = 0; i <= HUE_STEPS; i++) {
      float hue = (float) i / HUE_STEPS;
      FRACTIONS[i] = hue;
      // COLORS[i] = Color.getHSBColor(hue, 1f, 1f);
      COLORS[i] = Color.getHSBColor(hue, .8f, 1f);
    }
  }

  private float rotation;

  // ...

  // Generate an Area for the border area
  // (outer frame - inner frame).
  protected static Area createBorderArea(
      int x, int y, int width, int height) {
    Shape outer = new RoundRectangle2D.Float(
        x, y,
        width - 1f, height - 1f,
        CORNER_RADIUS, CORNER_RADIUS);
    Shape inner = new RoundRectangle2D.Float(
        x + BORDER_WIDTH,
        y + BORDER_WIDTH,
        width - BORDER_WIDTH * 2f - 1f,
        height - BORDER_WIDTH * 2f - 1f,
        CORNER_RADIUS - BORDER_WIDTH * 2f,
        CORNER_RADIUS - BORDER_WIDTH * 2f);
    Area area = new Area(outer);
    area.subtract(new Area(inner));
    return area;
  }

  @Override public void paintBorder(
      Component c, Graphics g,
      int x, int y, int width, int height) {
    Graphics2D g2 = (Graphics2D) g.create();
    g2.setRenderingHint(
        RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING,
        RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
    float cx = x + width * .5f;
    float cy = y + height * .5f;

    // By setting half of the diagonal (distance to the corner)
    // as radius, the entire gradient will fit within the
    // component and all colors will be displayed evenly.
    float gradientRadius =
        (float) Math.hypot(width, height) * .5f;
    float dx = (float) (Math.cos(getRotation()) * gradientRadius);
    float dy = (float) (Math.sin(getRotation()) * gradientRadius);
    g2.setPaint(new LinearGradientPaint(
        new Point2D.Float(cx - dx, cy - dy),
        new Point2D.Float(cx + dx, cy + dy),
        FRACTIONS, COLORS));
    g2.fill(createBorderArea(x, y, width, height));
    g2.dispose();
  }
}

class RotatingConicRainbowBorder extends RotatingRainbowBorder {
  // Offscreen buffer that regenerates only on resize
  private transient BufferedImage offscreen;
  private int cachedWidth;
  private int cachedHeight;

  // ...

  @Override public void paintBorder(
      Component c, Graphics g,
      int x, int y, int width, int height) {
    // Regenerate offscreen buffer only if size changes
    if (offscreen == null
        || cachedWidth != width || cachedHeight != height) {
      offscreen = new BufferedImage(
          width, height, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
      cachedWidth = width;
      cachedHeight = height;
    }
    Area borderArea = createBorderArea(x, y, width, height);

    Graphics2D g2 = offscreen.createGraphics();
    g2.setRenderingHint(
        RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING,
        RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
    g2.setComposite(AlphaComposite.Clear);
    g2.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    // Pass 1: Draw border shape with AA enabled
    // → Edge alpha is smooth
    g2.setComposite(AlphaComposite.Src);
    g2.fill(borderArea);
    g2.dispose();

    // Pass 2: Pixel-direct conic gradient while
    // preserving AA alpha from pass 1
    renderConicGradient(offscreen, borderArea, getRotation());

    g.drawImage(offscreen, 0, 0, null);
  }

  // Draw a conic gradient only on pixels in the border area.
  private static void renderConicGradient(
      BufferedImage offscreen, Area borderArea, float rotation) {
    int width = offscreen.getWidth();
    int height = offscreen.getHeight();
    double cx = width * .5;
    double cy = height * .5;
    int[] pixels = ((DataBufferInt) offscreen.getRaster()
        .getDataBuffer()).getData();
    Rectangle bounds = borderArea.getBounds();
    for (int py = bounds.y; py < bounds.y + bounds.height; py++) {
      for (int px = bounds.x; px < bounds.x + bounds.width; px++) {
        int dstAlpha = (pixels[py * width + px] >>> 24) & 0xFF;
        if (dstAlpha == 0) {
          continue;
        }
        double angle = Math.atan2(py - cy, px - cx) - rotation;
        double v = angle / (2d * Math.PI);
        double t = (v % 1d + 1d) % 1d;
        int rgb = interpolateColorRgb(t) & 0x00_FF_FF_FF;
        pixels[py * width + px] = (dstAlpha << 24) | rgb;
      }
    }
  }

  // ...
}
}}

* Description [#description]
上記のサンプルでは、`EmptyBorder`を継承して`paintBorder(...)`をオーバーライドし、その余白に虹色のグラデーションで塗りつぶした角丸の枠線を描画しています。上下`2`つの`JLabel`はグラデーションの生成方法のみが異なります。

- 虹色グラデーションの色配列:
-- `Color.getHSBColor(hue, .8f, 1f)`で色相を`HUE_STEPS`(`24`)等分した色配列`COLORS`と、その位置を示す`FRACTIONS`を`static`初期化子で生成
-- 配列の要素数を`HUE_STEPS + 1`として先頭と末尾を同じ色相(`0f`と`1f`)にすることで、グラデーションが一周しても色の継ぎ目が発生しない
-- 彩度を`1f`ではなく`.8f`に下げて、やや淡い虹色に調整

- 枠線の描画領域:
-- 外側の角丸矩形から`BORDER_WIDTH`分だけ内側に縮小した角丸矩形を`Area#subtract(...)`で除去し、枠線の形をした`Area`を生成
-- この`Area`を`Graphics2D#fill(...)`で塗りつぶすため、`Graphics2D#setClip(Shape)`で切り抜く場合とは異なり、アンチエイリアスが有効になる
-- 内側の角丸半径を`CORNER_RADIUS - BORDER_WIDTH * 2f`とすることで、外側の角丸と同心になるよう調整

- アニメーション:
-- `AnimatedLabel`が`javax.swing.Timer`(`16ms`間隔)で`rotation`を`.08f`ずつ加算し、`RotatingRainbowBorder#setRotation(float)`で設定して`repaint()`を実行
-- `JLabel#addNotify()`、`JLabel#removeNotify()`をオーバーライドして`Timer`を開始、停止することで、コンポーネントが非表示の間の無駄な再描画を回避

- 上: `LinearGradientPaint`による線形グラデーション:
-- コンポーネントの中心を通り、`rotation`で角度が変化する直線の両端を`LinearGradientPaint`の開始点と終了点に設定
-- グラデーションの半径を`Math.hypot(width, height) * .5f`(対角線の半分)にすることで、直線がどの角度に回転してもグラデーション全体がコンポーネント内に収まり、すべての色が均等に表示される
-- 平行な色の帯が回転するため、対向する辺には常に同系色が現れる

- 下: ピクセル単位で計算するコニックグラデーション(円錐グラデーション):
-- `Java 2D`の標準`API`には`LinearGradientPaint`や`RadialGradientPaint`は存在するが、中心点から扇状に色が変化する`ConicGradient`は存在しないため、`BufferedImage`のピクセルを直接操作して生成
--- [[EmptyBorderの余白に沿って光グラデーションが周回するアニメーションを描画する>Swing/GlowingBorder]]
--- [[JPanelに色相環を描画する>Swing/ColorWheel]]
-- パス`1`: アンチエイリアスを有効にした`Graphics2D`と`AlphaComposite.Src`で、透明な`BufferedImage`に枠線の`Area`を塗りつぶし、エッジがなめらかなアルファ値をもつマスクを生成
-- パス`2`: `DataBufferInt`から取得した`int[]`を直接走査し、`Math.atan2(py - cy, px - cx) - rotation`で求めた角度を`0.0 .. 1.0`に正規化した`t`から、`interpolateColorRgb(t)`で線形補間(`lerp`)した色を取得
--- アルファ値はパス`1`の値をそのまま維持して`RGB`のみを差し替えるため、`AlphaComposite.SrcAtop`を使用する場合と同様のソフトクリップとなり、角丸部分にジャギーが発生しない
--- アルファ値が`0`のピクセルはスキップし、走査範囲も`Area#getBounds()`に限定して処理量を削減
-- `BufferedImage`はサイズが変化した場合のみ再生成してキャッシュ
-- 中心からの角度で色が決まるため、虹色が枠線に沿って周回するように見える

#en{{
The above sample extends `EmptyBorder` and overrides `paintBorder(...)` to draw a rounded border filled with a rainbow gradient in its margin. The two `JLabel`s differ only in how the gradient is generated.

- Rainbow color arrays:
    - A `static` initializer generates the color array `COLORS` with `Color.getHSBColor(hue, .8f, 1f)`, dividing the hue into `HUE_STEPS`(`24`) equal steps, together with `FRACTIONS`, which holds their positions
    - Since the arrays have `HUE_STEPS + 1` elements and the first and last entries share the same hue (`0f` and `1f`), no seam appears where the gradient wraps around
    - The saturation is lowered from `1f` to `.8f` to obtain a slightly softer rainbow

- Border painting area:
    - An `Area` shaped like a frame is created by subtracting, with `Area#subtract(...)`, a rounded rectangle shrunk inward by `BORDER_WIDTH` from the outer rounded rectangle
    - This `Area` is filled with `Graphics2D#fill(...)`, so anti-aliasing is applied, unlike when the shape is clipped with `Graphics2D#setClip(Shape)`
    - The corner radius of the inner shape is set to `CORNER_RADIUS - BORDER_WIDTH * 2f` so that it is concentric with the outer rounded corners

- Animation:
    - `AnimatedLabel` uses a `javax.swing.Timer` (`16ms` interval) to increase `rotation` by `.08f`, applies it with `RotatingRainbowBorder#setRotation(float)`, and calls `repaint()`
    - `JLabel#addNotify()` and `JLabel#removeNotify()` are overridden to start and stop the `Timer`, avoiding useless repaints while the component is not displayed

- Top: linear gradient with `LinearGradientPaint`:
    - The start and end points of the `LinearGradientPaint` are the two ends of a line that passes through the center of the component and whose angle changes with `rotation`
    - Setting the gradient radius to `Math.hypot(width, height) * .5f` (half of the diagonal) makes the whole gradient fit inside the component at any rotation angle, so all colors are displayed evenly
    - Because parallel color bands rotate, opposite edges always show similar colors

- Bottom: conic gradient computed per pixel:
    - The standard `Java 2D` API provides `LinearGradientPaint` and `RadialGradientPaint`, but there is no `ConicGradient` whose color changes in a fan shape from a center point, so it is generated by directly manipulating the pixels of a `BufferedImage`
        - [Draw an animation where a glowing gradient rotates along the margins of an EmptyBorder](GlowingBorder.html)
        - [Drawing a Color Wheel on a JPanel](ColorWheel.html)
    - Pass `1`: with anti-aliasing enabled and `AlphaComposite.Src`, the border `Area` is filled into a transparent `BufferedImage` to create a mask whose edges have smooth alpha values
    - Pass `2`: the `int[]` obtained from `DataBufferInt` is scanned directly, and the color linearly interpolated (`lerp`) by `interpolateColorRgb(t)` is applied, where `t` is the angle `Math.atan2(py - cy, px - cx) - rotation` normalized to `0.0 .. 1.0`
        - The alpha values from pass `1` are kept as is and only the `RGB` components are replaced, which acts as the same kind of soft clipping as `AlphaComposite.SrcAtop` and keeps the rounded corners free of jaggies
        - Pixels whose alpha is `0` are skipped, and the scan is restricted to `Area#getBounds()` to reduce the amount of processing
    - The `BufferedImage` is cached and regenerated only when its size changes
    - Since the color is determined by the angle from the center, the rainbow appears to travel along the border
}}
